text:
alex.partnerships: Quick sync: vendor roadmap update — Gaudi microcode + MI300 driver patch landed in their Q2. They want coordinated marketplace refresh + partner announcement. Window proposed: May 20-22 (APAC-friendly). Need to align on maintenance, SI dry runs, and a single announcement cadence.

jiro.apac-ops: Noted. Are they bundling Gaudi and MI300 in the same publish? That could complicate fallbacks between Gaudi/B200 and MI300/H200.

alex.partnerships: They suggested separate pushes but within same week. Gaudi first (maintenance), MI300 follow for a driver hotfix. They also requested our marketplace manifest to include driver_version and microcode_sha fields.

anya.platform: Marketplace pipeline can accept extra fields, but we'll need schema version bump and tests. If partner wants SKU refresh within 48h, we should automate ingestion to avoid manual steps.

diego.eng-ml: From the runtime side, MI300 driver changes may affect kernel selection for quantized kernels. We should schedule a model-level smoke test (few representative workloads) during the SI dry run to check perf and correctness.

lina.si-lead: SI (RetailGen, LegalDoc, MedRecall) can run smoke tests but need at least 48h notice. Prefer not to run both Gaudi + MI300 dry runs back-to-back; we need a day gap. Otherwise resource contention.

jiro.apac-ops: Ops proposal: Gaudi maintenance Tue 2026-05-20 02:00-04:00 UTC (canary -> 4h monitor -> ramp), MI300 driver Wed 2026-05-21 03:00-05:00 UTC (shorter canary). Dry runs: 24h before each window, 90m slot.

anya.platform: I'll add manifest schema v2.1 and a CI job to validate and tag SKUs. Automation: partner POST -> marketplace-ci validates manifest -> pipeline tags SKUs and triggers marketplace cache purge. We can commit to 48h SLA if manifest arrives signed within that window.

diego.eng-ml: For fallbacks, propose: H100/H200 preferred for heavy gen workloads; MI300 as first fallback in APAC for certain models, B200 only as last resort. Need runtime flag to map model families to preferred hardware.

lina.si-lead: Can we get a compatibility matrix from the vendor mapping microcode/driver -> runtime kernel behavior? SI teams require guidance which models to run where for smoke tests.

alex.partnerships: I'll push for the matrix and signed manifests. Also asking vendor for an embargo window for the joint announcement: they want coordinated press 72h after successful rollout, but they can accept earlier if we provide post-deploy perf snapshots.

jiro.apac-ops: Risk callouts: Gaudi rollback is usually fast, MI300 driver rollback may require node reboots and rolling driver replacement (longer). We'll need an extended rollback SLA for MI300 (24-48h window).

anya.platform: Action for platform: create ingestion token, publish schema docs, add automated post-deploy hook to trigger SKU refresh. I'll also add a CI test job that runs a manifest through a staging ingest.

diego.eng-ml: I'll prepare a small eval suite (3 models: convo gen, long-format summarization, retrieval rerank) to run during dry runs and post-deploy. We'll capture p50/p95/p99, mem utilization, and correctness checks.

lina.si-lead: SI will block 2 engineers per dry run. We prefer dry runs at 09:00-10:30 APAC local to catch daytime support.

alex.partnerships: Proposed timeline recap:
- T-48h before each push: vendor submits signed manifest + compatibility matrix
- T-24h: 90m dry run (SI smoke + diego eval suite)
- Deploy windows: 2026-05-20 02:00-04:00 UTC (Gaudi); 2026-05-21 03:00-05:00 UTC (MI300)
- Post-deploy: 48-72h perf sampling and marketplace SKU refresh if all green
- Announcement: coordinated press/partner comms 72h after green or earlier with perf snapshots

anya.platform: I'll create the schema PR and pre-provision token for vendor.

j iro.apac-ops: I'll schedule oncall and maintenance calendar entries and put a slack incident stub.

lina.si-lead: SI dry run slots requested to vendor: please confirm engineers and test accounts.

diego.eng-ml: Will publish eval suite and runbook in #eng-ml.

release-bot: Maintenance windows created: #gaudi-maint-2026-05-20 (02:00-04:00Z), #mi300-driver-2026-05-21 (03:00-05:00Z). Incident stubs: INC-6270, INC-6271.

alex.partnerships: Thanks everyone. Action items: Alex - vendor ask + embargo/manifest; Jiro - oncall + calendar + rollback plan; Anya - schema + token + CI; Diego - eval suite + smoke tests; Lina - SI resources + dry run scheduling. We'll do a prep sync Fri EOD if vendor confirms. :white_check_mark:
